description: The session scheduled for the evening of Nov 5 never ran overnight: the Mac entered clamshell sleep on battery shortly before the scheduled start and stayed asleep (maintenance dark wakes only) until the lid was opened the next morning. The scheduled task fired only after the full wake, past the five-in-the-morning cutoff, so no experiments were run. Nothing in the program can keep the machine awake from a closed-lid, on-battery sleep; it needs the lid open on AC power or a change to power settings, which is Chris's call.
